title: Corvane invoice retry pull request
brief:
I'm Lucia Ferrante, a developer at Corvane Billing, and I need a pull request page for pull request 2231 that three reviewers, Amir Haddad, Joon Park and Sana Qureshi, will read on their phones between meetings. Sections: "Summary": invoice exports to the accounting partner failed whenever the partner's service was slow, about 1 batch in 20 of our 1200-invoice nightly batches, so this change retries a timed-out upload up to 4 times with waits of 2, 4, 8 and 16 seconds, a total wait of 30 seconds, after the 10 second timeout. "Files changed": a table: invoice_export.py +14 -4; test_invoice_export.py +31 -0; settings.py +2 -0. "The change": show this code with line numbers so reviewers can say which line they mean:
1 def export_invoices(client, batch):
2     sent = 0
3     for invoice in batch:
4         attempt = 0
5         while True:
6             try:
7                 client.post('/invoices', invoice.to_dict())
8                 sent += 1
9                 break
10            except TimeoutError:
11                attempt += 1
12                if attempt > 4:
13                    raise
14                time.sleep(2 ** attempt)
15    return sent
"What to look at": a list, with the first item flagged as the one I most want eyes on: the retry resends the same invoice, and the partner has only supported an idempotency key since 2026-09-14, which this code does not send yet, so a slow success could create a duplicate; also the wait blocks the whole batch. "Rollout": 10 percent of nightly batches from 2026-11-03, all batches from 2026-11-10 if no duplicates are reported.

edit.request: Change the retry limit from 4 to 3, which makes the total wait 14 seconds, and start the rollout at 25 percent instead of 10 percent.
